features.name: Zombie Bite
features.description: You can use your bite to make unarmed strikes. When you hit with them, the strike deals 1d6 + your Constitution modifier piercing damage, instead of the bludgeoning damage normal for an unarmed strike.

features.name: Poison Immunity
features.description: You are immune to poison damage and the poisoned condition.

features.name: Relentless Endurance
features.description: When you are reduced to 0 hit points but not killed outright, you can drop to 1 hit point instead. You can't use this feature again until you finish a long rest.

features.name: Infectious Bite
features.description: When you hit a creature that isn’t a Construct or Undead with your Zombie Bite, you can force it to make a Constitution saving throw against a DC equal to 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Constitution modifier. On a failed save, the creature is poisoned for 1 minute. At the end of each of its turns, it can repeat the saving throw, ending the condition on a success. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, regaining all expended uses when you finish a long rest.
